nAdADInamatastrayam ॥ nAdena vyajyate varRaH padaM varRAt padAdvacaH । vacaso vyavahAro'yaM nAdADInamato jagat ॥ Ahato'nAhataSceti dviDA nAdo nigadyate ॥ so'yaM prakASate piRqe tasmAt piRqo'BiDIyate ॥ “DarmmArTakAmamokzARAmidamevEkasADanam ॥ nAdavidyAM parAM labDA sarasvatyAH prasAdataH । kambalASvatarO nAgO SamBoH kuRqalatAM gatO ॥ paSuH SiSurmfgo vApi nAdena parituzyati । ato nAdasya mAhAtmyaM vyAKyAtuM kena Sakyate ॥” AYjaneyaH । “nAdAbdestu paraM pAraM na jAnAti sarasvatI । adyApi majjanaBayAttumbaM vahati vakzasi ॥” aTa nAdotpattiprakAraH । “AtmanA preritaM cittaM vahnimAhanti dehajam । AvirBAvayatItyevaM paYcaDA kIrttyate buDEH ॥” “nakAraM prARanAmAnaM dakAramanalaM viduH । jAtaH prARAgnisaMyogAttena nAdo'BiDIyate ॥” ayantu yogisaMvedya eva । asya avasTAdikaM yaduktaM haWayogapradIpikAyAm । 4 । 65-107 । “aSakyatattvaboDAnAM mUQAnAmapi saMmatam । proktaM gorakzanATena nAdopAsanamucyate ॥ SrIAdinATena sapAdakowilayaprakArAH kaTitA jayanti । nAdAnusanDAnakamekameva manyAmahe muKyatamaM layAnAm ॥ muktAsane sTito yogI mudrAM sanDAya SAmBavIm । SfRuyAddakziRe karRe nAdamantaHsTamekaDIH ॥ SravaRapuwanayanayugalaGrARamuKAnAM niroDanaM kAryyam । SudDasuzumnAsaraRO sPuwamamalaH SrUyate nAdaH ॥ ArammaSca GawaScEva taTA paricayo'pi ca ॥ nizpattiH sarvvayogezu syAdAvasTAcatuzwayam । aTAramBAvasTA । brahmagranTerBavedBedo hyAnandaH SUnyasamBavaH । vicitraH kvaRako dehe'nAhataH SrUyate DvaniH ॥ divyadehaSca tejasvI divyaganDastvarogavAn । saMpUrRahfdayaH SUnya AramBo yogavAn Bavet ॥ aTa GawAvasTA । dbitIyAyAM GawIkftya vAyurBavati maDyagaH । dfQAsano BavedyogI jYAnI devasamastadA ॥ vizRugranTestato BedAt paramAnandasUcakaH । atiSUnye vimardaSca BerISabdastaTA Bavet ॥ tftIyAyAM tu vijYeyo vihAyomardalaDvaniH । mahASUnyaM tadA yAti sarvvasidDisamASrayam ॥ cittAnandaM tadA jitvA sahajAnandasammavaH । dozaduHKajarAvyADikzuDAnidrAvivarjjitaH ॥ rudragranTiM yadA BitvA SarvvapIWagato'nilaH । nizpattO vERavaH SabdaH kvaRadbIRAkvaRo Bavet ॥ ekIBUtaM tadA cittaM rAjayogABiDAnakam । sfzwisaMhArakarttAsO yogISvarasamo Bavet ॥ astu vA mAstu vA muktiratrEvAKaRqitaM suKam । layodBavamidaM sOKyaM rAjayogAdavApyate ॥ rAjayogamajAnantaH kevalaM haWakarmiRaH । etAnaByAsino manye prayAsaPalavarjjitAn ॥ unmanyavAptaye SIGraM BrUDyAnaM mama saMmatam । rAjayogapadaM prAptaM suKopAyo'lpacetasAm ॥ sadyaH pratyayasanDAyI jAyate nAdajo layaH ॥ nAdAnusanDAnasamADiBAjAM yogISvarARAM hfdi vardDamAnam । AnandamekaM vacasAmagamyaM jAnAti taM SrIgurunATa ekaH ॥ karRO piDAya hastAByAM yaM SfRoti DvaniM muniH । tatra cittaM sTirIkuryyAdyAvatsTirapadaM vrajet ॥ aByasyamAno nAdo'yaM bAhyamAvfRute Gvanim । pakzAdvikzepamaKilaM jitvA yogI suKI Bavet ॥ SrUyate praTamAByAse nAdo nAnAviDo mahAn । tato'ByAse varDamAne SrUyate sUkzmasUkzmakaH ॥ AdO jalaDijImUtaBerIJarJarasamBavAH । maDye mardalaSaNKotTA GaRwAkAhalajAstaTA ॥ ante tu kiNkiRIvaMSavIRABramaraniHsvanAH । iti nAnAviDA nAdAH SrUyante dehamaDyagAH ॥ mahati SrUyamARe'pi meGaBeryyAdike DvanO । tatra sUkzmAt sUkzmataraM nAdameva parAmfSet ॥ Ganamutsfjya vA sUkzme sUkzmamutsfjya vA Gane । ramamARamapi kziptaM mano nAnyatra cAlayet ॥ yatra kutrApi vA nAde lagati praTamaM manaH । tatrEva susTirIBUya tena sArdDaM vilIyate ॥ makarandaM piban BfNgo ganDaM nApekzate yaTA । nAdAsaktaM taTA cittaM vizayAnna hi kANkzate ॥ manomattagajendrasya vizayodyAnacAriRaH । niyamane samarTo'yaM ninAdaniSitANkuSaH ॥ badDaM tu nAdabanDena manaH saMtyaktacApalam । prayAti sutarAM sTEryyaM CinnapakzaH Kago yaTA ॥ sarvvacintAM parityajya sAvaDAnena cetasA Dvanirya upalaByate । DvanerantargataM jYeyaM jYeyasyAntargataM manaH । manastatra layaM yAti tadbizRoH paramaM padam ॥ tAvadAkASasaNkalpo yAvacCabdaH pravarttate । niHSabdaM tatparaM brahma bIjaM haWaH kzetramOdAsInyaM jalaM triBiH । unmanI kalpalatikA sadya eva pravarttate ॥ sadA nAdAnusanDAnAt kzIyante pApasaYcayAH । niraYjane vilIyete niScitaM cittamArutO ॥ SaNKadunduBinAdaYca na ISvaramuneH puttraH । nyAyatattvayogarahasyayoH praRetA । asya vAsasTAnaM dAkziRAtyapradeSaH ॥)

m: नाद m. (√ नद्) a loud sound, roaring, bellowing, crying, RV. &c. &c.
any sound or tone, Prāt.; R. &c. (= शब्द, L.)
(in the Yoga) the nasal sound represented by a semicircle and used as an abbreviation in mystical words, BhP.
a praiser (= स्तोतृ), Naigh. iii, 16.
a: नादः — [नद्-घञ्] 1 A loud roar, ery, shout, sounding, roaring; सिंहनादः, घन˚ &c. --2 A sound in general; Māl. 5. 20. --3 (In Yoga phil.) The nasal sound represented by a semi-circle ( ◡ ). --4 One who praises.
